part.text:
I rewrote `message.md` in a calmer, more concise tone. No other files were changed.

> The export scheduled for 14:00 UTC has been delayed and will be ready by 16:00 UTC. This is only a delay: your existing data is unaffected. We'll send you an email as soon as the export is ready.

Every fact is still there: the 14:00 UTC schedule, the 16:00 UTC ready time, existing data being unaffected, and the email notice. I replaced the all-caps "THIS IS A DELAY, DO NOT PANIC" with "This is only a delay," which keeps the reassurance without the alarm.
